response.inner_monologue: I am teaching a parts store crew about electric cars and autonomous systems today, and I am charging them $500 for it, and that $500 is the only thing standing between me and a month where I cannot pay the mortgage. That is the reality I am living in right now. I built a business for twenty-eight years and I am starting over with a two-hour session in a auto parts store and I am not going to pretend that is not what it is. But I showed up to that legal pad in tick one and the right column did not say driving anywhere -- it said teaching, it said reading anxiety, it said building confidence in someone who wants to quit. That is what I do today. I do not know if the adult ed coordinator is going to call me back. I do not know if the retraining fund comes through. I know I show up prepared and I do not apologize for the fee.
